request: A gate command's flake count in telemetry has crossed the quarantine threshold without the command being quarantined yet. Add it to .torve/gates.yaml's quarantine list (RFC 0002 §6a, D-2.15) — or fix the underlying flake — so it stops consuming poison-ceiling attempts while still being run and reported.
